scope: Post-hoc description of one accepted paired training seed; no independent-epoch inference.

code_evidence.observation: Known-class fractions and correctness use ground truth only for audit summaries.
A transferred pseudo label changes both its class target and pseudo_mask.
pseudo_mask selects supervised contrastive examples; its complement selects triplet examples.

interpretation: More correct known-class assignments account for most of the increase in pseudo-label count; mean novel-class assignments to known labels remain almost unchanged.
The proposed explanation that the larger pool simply adds more novel-class mislabels is not supported by these aggregate counts.
Known-class supervision and exclusion from the triplet branch are coupled by pseudo_mask. This is an observed code path, not proof that it causes the final NEW decrease.
The larger best-to-final decline in the complete arm is descriptive; it cannot replace the frozen final-epoch comparison.
decision: Stop this candidate-completion branch; no automatic additional seed or GPU commitment.
unresolved_question: Does removing pseudo-labelled images from the unsupervised triplet branch contribute to the old/new tradeoff?
future_discriminator: A separately registered complete-pool control can retain pseudo-labelled images in the triplet branch while preserving pseudo-label supervision, the complete CUB protocol and fixed-final evaluation. Log branch populations and gradients; do not use unlabeled ground truth to choose training samples.
